definitions.explanation: A man with attractive physical features. Somewhat literary or formal compared to everyday terms like イケメン.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{美男|びなん}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: He is famous for being handsome.

examples.japanese: {美男|びなん}{美女|びじょ}のカップルだ。
examples.english: They are a couple of a handsome man and a beautiful woman.

examples.japanese: あの{俳優|はいゆう}は{美男|びなん}として{知|し}られているが、{演技力|えんぎりょく}も{高|たか}い。
examples.english: That actor is known as a handsome man, but he also has great acting ability.

notes:
Composed of {美|び} (beautiful) + {男|なん} (man). A classical-sounding word for a good-looking man. The fuller form {美男子|びなんし} is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美男|びなん}{美女|びじょ}: handsome man and beautiful woman (an attractive couple)
- {美男子|びなんし}: handsome man (slightly more emphatic)
- {美男|びなん}{俳優|はいゆう}: handsome actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- イケメン: good-looking guy — casual, modern slang; the most common everyday term
- {男前|おとこまえ}: handsome, manly — emphasizes masculine attractiveness
- {美女|びじょ}: beautiful woman — the female counterpart
